integrity: The proof enumerates exhaustive symbolic cases. Exact finite-label enumerations are consistency checks, not proofs for all graph orders.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary Roman domination; P4-sparse decomposition is prior work; general polynomial-time existence on bounded clique-width is prior-implied. The novelty is explicit all-coefficient spider transformations and head-substitution behavior, not generic computability. Priority subject to specialized literature. Independent scientific audit not performed.
title: Roman domination weight polynomials of thin and thick spiders with arbitrary heads
